name: Seychelles International Airport

permits.v: non-scheduled flights and non-traffic stops must apply to the SAA Flight Clearance Office at least 72 hours before the flight; urgent requests outside this period are considered only with full justification; office open Mon-Fri 05:00-12:00 UTC, Sat 05:00-08:00 UTC, closed Sundays and public holidays
permits.quote: at least 72 hours prior to operation of the flight
